ios.desc:
Introducing the new Igloo: a complete overhaul delivering an IRC Client with enhanced performance and stability. This latest version, reengineered from the ground up, offers a refined user experience while maintaining the simplicity and versatility you expect from Igloo.

What's New:
• Multi-File DCC/XDCC: Enhanced to support simultaneous file transfers, now conveniently stored locally for immediate access.
• Redesigned User Interface: A cleaner, more intuitive UI paired with a selection of themes, elevating your chat experience.
• Optimized for Bouncers: Advanced features tailored for a seamless experience with popular bouncers like ZNC.

Core Features:
• Comprehensive Network Support: Compatible with all IRC networks, including Freenode, Libera, Rizon, EFnet, and more.
• Secure Communication: Ensured by SSL/TLS encryption.
• ZNC Integration: Seamless integration with ZNC and a Push Notification module (https://push.igloo.app).
• Versatile File Sharing: File, image, audio, and video sharing supported through platforms like Arxius.io and Imgur.com.
• Enhanced Input Completion: For channels, nicks, and commands.
• Inline Media Viewing: Experience inline media display for a more engaging chat environment.
• Customization and Compliance: Customize your experience with inline nick coloring, full formatting with 99 color support, and adherence to IRCv3 standards.
• VoiceOver Accessibility: Enhanced accessibility features including VoiceOver integration to support our vision-impaired users.

We're committed to evolving Igloo based on your feedback. If there are features you'd like to see in future updates, please let us know at contact@igloo.app or join us at #igloo on iglooirc.com.

Terms of Service: https://igloo.app/terms
Privacy Policy https://igloo.app/privacy
